newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was very slow late Wednesday. Few sales of slaughter steers and heifers finished steady with late last week.

Inquiry was moderate and demand light. Sales confirmed on 1,300 slaughter steers and 1,700 heifers. For the week to date on 16,000 head including 10,900 head previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 1000-1050 lbs 67.00, couple pens 67.25-67.50, pen select with end choice 1135 lbs 66.00.
Wk to date- 16,000 last week - 60,100 last year - 72,100
